messages:
nina: Running into an edge-runtime bug when trying to run our SDK in an Expo + Edge environment. Error: 'crypto.subtle' is undefined in Hermes/V8 snapshots. Works on desktop browsers.

marco: sounds like WebCrypto vs React Native global crypto mismatch. Edge runtimes (Cloudflare/Workers/Deno) expose subtle usually, but RN/Hermes only has getRandomValues via polyfills. Are you targeting an 'edge' build?

nina: yes, we added an experimental `edge` export that points to dist/edge/index.mjs and tried to use it from a Next.js edge middleware that also mounts an RN webview in our sample. The edge bundle expects `crypto.subtle.digest` and throws when absent.

jen: two approaches: 1) make the edge build rely only on universal APIs (avoid subtle) or 2) ship a tiny conditional polyfill that detects subtle and provides a JS fallback using libs like 'fast-sha256' for digest, and ensure the edge export imports the polyfill synchronously.

marco: also watch exports mapping. If package.json has conditional exports like {"react-native":"./dist/rn/index.js","edge":"./dist/edge/index.mjs"} modern bundlers will pick correctly, but older toolchains and Metro might ignore the 'edge' condition. For RN you must still have a react-native entry.

nina: typings were weird: TS suggested the edge import had no types. We were pointing "types" to dist/index.d.ts only. Any suggestions for multi-target types?

jen: publish separate d.ts files per entry and use the "types" and "exports" with "types": {"import":"./dist/index.d.ts","node":"./dist/node.d.ts","react-native":"./dist/rn.d.ts","edge":"./dist/edge.d.ts"} pattern. Not all JS package managers support typed conditional exports, but TS will consult the exports/types map if present.

marco: dev tip: for Expo RN + edge hybrid tests, make the edge entry minimal and avoid runtime-reflective crypto usage. If you must use subtle, gate it: `const digest = crypto?.subtle ? await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data) : sha256Fallback(data)` so RN fast refresh doesn't suddenly throw.

nina: good call. I'll land a small edge polyfill + add `exports.edge` and per-entry d.ts files. Also adding a README note about which runtime each export targets to reduce onboarding confusion.

devex-bot: CI note: sample-edge-integration job flagged missing crypto subtleties in edge tests. Ticket #1201 created.
